title: Q-YEAR-SIM-node-eol-upgrade: the pinned Node release leaves maintenance on 2027-04-30
body:

**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation yearsim --probe node-eol-upgrade
**Status:** closed

Fault class `node-eol-upgrade`: the pinned Node release leaves maintenance on 2027-04-30. Drill evidence: pins: 22 x10, 24 x1; earliest end of maintenance 2027-04-30; automatic rewrite to 24 works: True. Fix: python3 -m foundation yearsim --fix-node --apply (bump node_eol and node_lts in doctrine/yearsim.json first when a newer LTS exists)

Build the mechanism that recovers from it without a person, then the drill in foundation/yearsim.py must exercise it.

size: M
